committee: * Presentation Notice for Legislative Certificate No. 483-38 (COR) - Office of Legislative Secretary
location: Grand Ballroom of the Dusit Thani Guam Resort
title: Håfa Adai, Please join me in presenting Legislative Certificate No. 483-38 (COR), which recognizes the contributions of the volunteers of I Hinanao, I Magåhet, Yan I Ininna (HMI), “By Veterans, For Veterans,” and their commitment to supporting Guam’s veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces and their families, on the occasion of HMI’s 4th Annual Veterans Gala. The presentation is scheduled for Friday, November 13, 2026, at 7:15 p.m. in the Grand Ballroom of the Dusit Thani Guam Resort.
